generationInputs.prompt: A stylized flat design image on a white background depicts a human figure with subdued flat colors and a slightly slumped posture, looking down. Light grey, almost transparent circular arrows swirl subtly around the person, illustrating a self-defeating loop. Extending from the foreground, a hand with bold flat colors offers a single, vibrant green leaf, positioned in front of the person, suggesting a path to break free. The hand symbolizes compassion and the leaf represents hope or a new beginning. The overall aesthetic is a minimalist illustration with clean lines and a vector art style, emphasizing the concept of escaping negative patterns.
